name: XD Widgets for Elementor
author: vinhxomdoi

sections.description:
XD Widgets for Elementor adds 13 clean, modern widgets to the free Elementor page builder, each with several ready-made style presets in a familiar page-builder style. Switching a preset only changes one class, so your content and Style tab edits are kept.

Requires the free Elementor plugin.

Live demo of all widgets · Plugin page & docs · Made by Vĩnh XD

Widgets:

  • Testimonial – 6 presets, star rating.
  • Team Member – 5 presets, repeatable social links.
  • Message Box – 6 presets, two buttons, dismissible (remembered for N days).
  • Lightbox – open from a button, image, text or any #xdwfe-lb-ID link; content from the editor, an Elementor template, an image or a video; optional auto-open by delay, scroll or exit intent.
  • Image Box – 7 presets.
  • Icon Box – 7 presets × 3 icon positions; icon, image or number.
  • Banner – 6 presets, 9-point content position, two buttons, “above the fold” option (fetchpriority=high).
  • Banner Grids – 7 layouts.
  • Slider – banner or Elementor template slides, slide or fade, native swipe (CSS scroll-snap).
  • Video Button – 4 presets, YouTube/Vimeo/MP4, the player is only created on click.
  • Title / Divider – 7 presets, wrap words in asterisks to highlight them.
  • Blog Posts – grid, list or slider; 5 card presets.
  • Scroll To – scroll anchors with header offset and a fixed dot navigation, or a “scroll down” button.

Performance:

  • Each widget has its own small CSS/JS file that only loads on pages using that widget.
  • No jQuery and no third-party libraries.
  • Images use wp_get_attachment_image (srcset, sizes, width/height, lazy loading).
  • Unused widgets can be turned off under Elementor → XD Widgets.

The plugin interface is currently in Vietnamese and is translation-ready.

This plugin is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Elementor Ltd. Elementor is a trademark of its respective owner.

External services

The plugin does not contact any external service by itself. Only when you add a YouTube or Vimeo link to the Video Button, Lightbox or Slider widget:

  • YouTube: the video cover image is loaded from i.ytimg.com when no custom cover is set, and the player (youtube-nocookie.com) is loaded only after the visitor clicks play. The video ID is sent. Terms, Privacy.
  • Vimeo: the player (player.vimeo.com) is loaded only after the visitor clicks play. The video ID is sent. Terms, Privacy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the free Elementor plugin.
  2. Upload the xd-widgets-for-elementor folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  3. Activate the plugin. The widgets appear in the “XD Widgets” category of the Elementor panel (type “XD” to filter).
sections.faq:
Does it work without Elementor?

No. The free Elementor plugin must be installed and active.

Can I change the accent color?

Yes. Widgets use Elementor’s Primary global color by default, and each widget has its own accent color control. You can also override the CSS variables –xdwfe-primary, –xdwfe-heading, –xdwfe-text, –xdwfe-radius and –xdwfe-shadow.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Security: all output is now escaped late with context-appropriate functions (esc_*, tag_escape, wp_kses with strict allowlists for images, SVG icons and editor content).
  • Security: video URLs are limited to http(s); saved-template output validates the template ID, type, status and password protection.
  • Elementor link/attribute output now uses print_render_attribute_string().

1.0.0

  • Initial release: 13 widgets, style presets, per-widget asset loading.

short_description: 13 lightweight widgets with ready-made style presets for Elementor. Assets load only on pages that use them.
